name: Omni Connect
summary:
Bring full-body movement to your Meta Quest with Omni Connect.

Omni Connect is the companion app for Omni One, Virtuix's full-body VR gaming system. Connect your Omni One treadmill to your Meta Quest headset and step into supported games using real-world movement. Walk, run, and crouch naturally as your movements translate directly into the virtual world.
